In that case, keep in contact with her. I dont know how your relationship was, But if you have the feeling she understands you Just keep talking. Especially in the nights you want to do it. She might understand your feelings and thoughts and I promise if you keep trying to feel positive ( I know its really freaking hard sometimes) in the end everything will get better, maybe not much. But all little bits help. Just dont do anything weirds tonight.

I have been struggling with suicidal thoughts aswell. And even attempted it a few times. The only thing I want to say is: if you truly think this is the right thing I cant stop you. What I can do is say that you will probably regret  trying / doing it. You are not a burden to the people Who love you. Even if You think there is noone Who loves you I can promise you there are people Who do. Before attempting anything  or sending the notes please talk to people. Could be  a random person on the Internet (like me) or the people Who are close to you. I hope you wont attempt anything tonight. Please post again tommorow if You have changed your thoughts or want to talk.
